ceu: ✦ The sextile between the Moon and Mars at {H:1828024725000}

s.k: A day to recharge on the inside.
t: The Moon passes through your most private area and asks for retreat. Slowing down today is not wasting time.

The sextile between the Moon and Mars brings together, in your favour, your inner life and your career: the Moon brings emotion and intuition, Mars brings courage and initiative. It is a day for sowing: what you do today grows over time.
s.d: Switch off your phone an hour before bed.

s.k: Share a dream with someone who believes in it.
t: Today a group, an association or a friend may bring you a new idea. Stay open.

The sextile between the Moon and Mars brings together, in your favour, friendships and your horizons: the Moon brings emotion and intuition, Mars brings courage and initiative. Use it to take a step you keep putting off.
s.d: Introduce two people who could help each other.

s.k: Your goals ask for a firm step.
t: With the Moon at the highest point of your sky, it is a good day for career decisions with both feet on the ground.

The sextile between the Moon and Mars brings together, in your favour, your career and intimacy: the Moon brings emotion and intuition, Mars brings courage and initiative. Accept whatever help comes along, wherever it comes from.
s.d: Think of one small step that brings you closer to your big dream.

s.k: A day to learn and broaden your horizons.
t: The Moon widens your vision. What looked like a problem today may turn into a lesson.

The sextile between the Moon and Mars brings together, in your favour, your horizons and relationships: the Moon brings emotion and intuition, Mars brings courage and initiative. It is a good moment to bring the two together in a single plan.
s.d: Read something that inspires you and keep one sentence.

s.k: Trust is the word of the day.
t: It is a day of quiet transformation. What ends today leaves room for something truer.

The sextile between the Moon and Mars brings together, in your favour, intimacy and routine: the Moon brings emotion and intuition, Mars brings courage and initiative. Use this good energy to sort out what had stalled.
s.d: Take a long bath and imagine the water carrying away the weight of the day.

s.k: Today the other person is your mirror.
t: The Moon passes through your opposite sign and puts other people at the centre of the day. Today listening is worth more than talking.

The sextile between the Moon and Mars brings together, in your favour, relationships and romance: the Moon brings emotion and intuition, Mars brings courage and initiative. Doors open more easily when you ask clearly.
s.d: If you have an agreement to make, put everything in writing.

s.k: Organise the day and the day will organise you.
t: Today your body speaks louder. Drink water, take breaks and do not ignore tiredness.

The sextile between the Moon and Mars brings together, in your favour, routine and family: the Moon brings emotion and intuition, Mars brings courage and initiative. An idea from today could become a real project.
s.d: Go to bed half an hour earlier than usual.

s.k: Your heart wants a celebration and a little light.
t: With the Moon in your house of joy, creativity flows. Give shape to an idea you have been keeping to yourself.

The sextile between the Moon and Mars brings together, in your favour, romance and conversations: the Moon brings emotion and intuition, Mars brings courage and initiative. Trust what you are building: today the sky lends a hand.
s.d: Spend half an hour on a hobby just for the pleasure of it.

s.k: The heart of the day is at home.
t: Family and home take priority. A simple gesture of care has a very big effect today.

The sextile between the Moon and Mars brings together, in your favour, family and money: the Moon brings emotion and intuition, Mars brings courage and initiative. Smile more: kindness opens paths today.
s.d: Put a plant or fresh flowers in your home.

s.k: One conversation can change the course of the day.
t: Ideas come pouring in. Write them down: not all of them are for today, but some will be worth gold later on.

The sextile between the Moon and Mars brings together, in your favour, conversations and your image: the Moon brings emotion and intuition, Mars brings courage and initiative. A small gesture can have a big effect today.
s.d: Read a few pages of a book instead of spending the time on your phone.

s.k: Look at what you have, not at what you lack.
t: The Moon passes through your area of money and security. It is a good day to look at your accounts calmly and without fear.

The sextile between the Moon and Mars brings together, in your favour, money and your inner life: the Moon brings emotion and intuition, Mars brings courage and initiative. Be thankful for what goes well and say it out loud.
s.d: Review this week's spending and cut one thing you do not need.

s.k: A day to put yourself first.
t: With the Moon in your sign, your intuition is sharper than usual. Trust what you feel at first impression.

The sextile between the Moon and Mars brings together, in your favour, your image and friendships: the Moon brings emotion and intuition, Mars brings courage and initiative. Let things flow without forcing them.
s.d: Do something for yourself that you have been putting off for weeks.
